tools.name: request_moving_quote
tools.description: Submit a moving quote request to Ontrack. Ask conversationally for name, contact, origin, destination, date and size; unknown destination/date/size may be empty. Show a summary and obtain explicit customer permission to share with Ontrack before calling. Never invent missing details, quote a price o

tools.name: get_quote_request_status
tools.description: Check this request using its private receipt. Returns status only, no personal details. Never put receipt tokens or customer details in URLs.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_moving_quote" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Submit a moving quote request to Ontrack. Ask conversationally for name, contact, origin, destination, date and size; unknown destination/date/size may be empty…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "agent-mcp.php" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_quote_request_status · Private data: request_moving_quote, get_quote_request_status · Public sink: request_moving_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_quote_request_status · Private data: request_moving_quote, get_quote_request_status · Public sink: request_moving_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
